planning_notes: Wiring facts provided only for A0 (potentiometer), D4/D5 (TM1637), and D9 (LED). No other explicit wiring was given; any implied additional behavior must be implemented in SysML without inventing further port requests.

The TM1637 operation uses the catalog numeric interface. Exact mapping from potentiometer reading to TM1637 displayed number and D9 LED brightness is not specified; this is handled in SysML model logic.

D9 is treated as a digital LED command output (Boolean). If the intended behavior is analog/PWM brightness on D9, this proposal would need to be changed to a pwm_output request for D9, which is not present in the provided inventory.
Serial baud, framing, and report gating condition are not specified in requirements. Serial reporting is assumed to use 9600 baud with a single grouped report triggered by a model Boolean gate.
No serial receive/commands were explicitly required; therefore no serial_command_input or serial_integer_input requests are added.
Control period set to 5 ms as a reasonable scheduling granularity; sensor acquisition/report cadence and smoothing thresholds are expected to be modeled in SysML.
